This is a reported improvement in coding task success, which weighs against a plateau in that evaluation [e2]. The comparison does not establish a broad, continuing capability trajectory or rule out an approaching ceiling across generative AI during April–June 2024 [e2].
limitations: The cited result is an internal developer evaluation, without independent confirmation in the packet [e2].
The comparison does not establish either a broad plateau or broad, continuing gains throughout the assessment quarter [e2].
The claim specifies no magnitude or duration of improvement compatible with 'peaking'.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Generative AI is peaking or has already peaked.

statement.excerpt: Generative AI, as I said back in March, is peaking, if it hasn't already peaked.

from_speaker: as I said back in March
our_interpretation: The surrounding sentences make substantive capability the plain referent of peaking, rather than revenue, popularity or investment.

I assess the current-state observation over April–June 2024, the latest completed quarter before the post. This reporting window is an evaluator choice because no standard reporting period exists for AI capabilities.
Peaking permits some remaining improvement; it is weaker than saying that no model improved during the quarter.
Later developments cannot serve as outcome evidence for this historical assessment.
criteria.support_condition: Representative evaluations during the target period show that substantive capabilities had broadly levelled off or were approaching a demonstrated ceiling.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations establish substantial, broad and continuing capability gains during the target period, sufficient to reject a plateau or approaching ceiling.
